headline: Summer transfer window: Grading big signings in men's soccer
description: The 2026 summer transfer window is open. Here is how we rated the biggest deals.

headline: Rodri seals transfer to Barcelona after seven-year stint at Man City
description: Spain's World Cup winning captain Rodri has completed his transfer from Manchester City to Barcelona.

headline: Premier League 2026-27 kits: Ranking every jersey released
description: The 2026-27 Premier League season is fast approaching, and every club has released at least one of their new jerseys. Here they all are -- ranked!

headline: Guglielmo Vicario joins Juventus on loan from Tottenham
description: Guglilemo Vicario has joined Juventus on a season-long loan from Tottenham, the two clubs have announced.

headline: Chelsea rebrand U21, U19 teams to 'Cobham Next Gen'
description: Chelsea have announced a rebrand of their under-21 and under-19 teams, confirming their new name as Cobham Next Gen (CNG).

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Galatasaray offer Bruno Fernandes double his salary
description: Galatasaray have stepped up their pursuit of Manchester United midfielder Bruno Fernandes. Transfer Talk has the latest.
